additions.description: GET /api/v1/password-recovery-html/{email} endpoint is implemented but not defined in the specification
additions.reasoning: The specification does not formally define a /password-recovery-html/{email} endpoint as a required API route. It appears only as an implementation detail used in one test scenario, not as a specified endpoint.

omissions.description: GET /api/v1/items/{item_id} does not check item ownership: any authenticated user can read any item, but the spec requires a 400 'Not enough permissions' response when a non-owner, non-superuser attempts to read an item
omissions.reasoning: The specification states: 'Attempt to read the created item using the access token of the second user. Verify that the response status code is 400 and the response body contains a detail field with the value Not enough permissions'. The code's read_item handler returns the item to any authenticated user without checking ownership.

omissions.description: POST /api/v1/users/signup returns detail 'User with this email already exists' instead of the required 'The user with this email already exists in the system'
omissions.reasoning: The specification test states: 'Verify the response body field detail equals The user with this email already exists in the system'. The code raises HTTPException(status_code=400, detail='User with this email already exists') which omits 'in the system'.
